snippet.title: Displacement Game Teaser
snippet.description:
WISH LIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2824520/Displacement/
JOIN DISCORD: https://discord.gg/QA5tyMvZ6H

Obelisk is an independent studio with experience on titles like Sons of the Forest, Far Cry 6, Dota 2, Love, Death & Robots, and many other amazing projects. For the past year, we’ve been working on our debut game — Displacement.

TODAY, THE PROJECT IS ON THE VERGE OF SHUTDOWN.

We're close to completing our Alpha vertical slice, but without attention from players and media, we won’t be able to secure funding and continue development.
Displacement is a dark, first-person survival horror with intense combat, a unique temperature system, and a chilling story of madness set in a polar research station. If you've been missing atmospheric single-player experiences — this is for you.
If you, like us, believe in independent, honest, and atmospheric games, please help us spread the word about Displacement.

WE NEED YOUR HELP!

Any post, wishlist, stream, or news coverage could be the turning point for this project.
For collaborations or interview inquiries, please contact us at: press@obeliskstd.com
#Obeliskstudio #survivalhorror #game #reveal #savedisplacement
